Table 1: Full backbone ablation combined with published baselines. All values are MSE / MAE. Per row, **bold** marks the best and underline the second best across all models present in that row. **Lookback lengths differ** : CycleNet rows use _L_ = 96; PatchTST/42, HDMixer, and our four backbones use _L_ = 336. HDMixer and PatchTST/42 do not report Solar at _L_ = 336. Ours: `seq len=336, batch size=32, lr=1e-3, seed=2024, auto/auto` .
